name: Frontend Dev Visual Memory Configuration
description: Configuration for memvid-based visual and chronological memory system

memvid.description: Single portable file containing all test memory, screenshots metadata, and search indices

available.name: create_or_open_memory
available.description: Initialize or access project memory file (.mv2)
available.usage: Call at session start to initialize memory

available.name: add_content
available.description: Store text documents, code snippets, test results, and metadata
available.usage: Store test results, screenshots paths, timeline events

available.name: search_memory
available.description: Query memory using hybrid search (lexical + semantic)
available.usage: Find previous test results, compare with baselines, query='*' lists all

available.name: ask_memory
available.description: Natural language queries about stored data (requires OpenAI API key)
available.usage: Ask questions like 'What tests failed last week?'

initialization.description: Initialize memory at start of testing session

storageTestResult.description: Store test results after each test run
storageTestResult.example: add_content with test result JSON and tags for page, status, date

queryHistory.example: search_memory with query 'dashboard tests failed' or '*' for all

compareBaselines.example: search_memory with query 'baseline screenshot dashboard desktop'

withConstitutions.description: Memory stores which constitution was used for each test
withConstitutions.benefit: Track test coverage and constitution effectiveness over time

withScreenshots.description: Screenshot files stored on disk, metadata/paths stored in memvid
withScreenshots.benefit: Fast search of screenshot metadata, actual images accessible via path

withTimeline.description: All events stored with timestamps for chronological querying
withTimeline.benefit: Reconstruct test history, understand what happened when
